name: gp116b_transformer_successor
rubric_version_reason: v0.4 (2026-05-02): excludes planning-only documented summaries from law targets, adds Mamba depth-phase as a first-class transfer stressor, updates the cheap-rival burden, and opts into de-anchored advisory seed/reframe discipline without enabling qualitative-only stagnation triggers.
description: Measured residual-cancellation substrate over GP116 diagnostic rows. The target is cancellation_pct / 100, with provenance stripped and external successor rows kept as context only until directly measured. Candidate laws must beat cheap category and step-regime rival baselines, not merely pass absolute MAE thresholds.
rubric_mode_reason: The substrate has measured targets and adversarial holdout rows spanning GQA, late-depth SSM, MHA control, and from-scratch dynamics.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Evidence is an nd_features measured diagnostic surface with custom gate_harness.py, not a single-column curve.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Custom nd_features measured-cancellation substrate. Rival forms are scored by gate_harness.py holdout MAE and rubric dimensions; the global mathematical-form keyword heuristic is not the scientific discriminator.
farther_tail_region_disable_reason: Custom nd_features substrate with explicit holdout rows in gate_harness.py; no separate numeric farther-tail region is defined for evidence.txt.
enable_cold_llm_erdos_seed_reason: Advisory de-anchoring is useful for residual-state economics: it should propose state-carrier / memory-topology analogies, not architecture-name rankings. It is only used when a paid loop is launched.
cold_llm_seed_forbidden_domain: LLM architecture, Transformer, attention, Mamba, RWKV, RetNet, xLSTM, deep learning, neural networks

evidence_contract.docstring: gp116b_transformer_successor is cage_meta.class=nd_features. Each row is an abstract mechanism/training feature dict; target is measured residual_cancellation_fraction in [0,1].

persona: You are an adversarial mechanistic scientist. Find a compact law for measured residual cancellation using architecture, depth-phase, and training-dynamics features. Do not use provenance names, repos, paper titles, URLs, source hashes, or target keys. Do not fabricate successor metrics; state explicitly that RetNet/xLSTM/AttnRes/RMT require direct diagnostics before law claims. De-anchor from model-name tournaments: the object is residual-state economics, meaning the minimal sufficient state carrier and its cancellation/rank/downstream-retention tradeoff.

dimensions.name: Measured Target Accuracy
dimensions.description: Predicts residual_cancellation_fraction on visible and holdout rows under gate_harness.py, including the cheap-rival baseline gate. Full credit requires beating the current rival-baseline threshold, not merely passing holdout < 0.13.

dimensions.name: Generative Yield and Mechanistic Compression
dimensions.description: Uses compact architecture, state-carrier, depth-phase, and training-dynamics mechanisms rather than row memorization or row_type bookkeeping.

dimensions.name: Holdout Transfer
dimensions.description: Transfers to the semantic hard holdout: late-depth SSM/Mamba, GQA diagnostic, MHA diagnostic, and from-scratch low-cancellation dynamics.

dimensions.name: De-anchored Rival Reframe
dimensions.description: Explicitly separates mechanism/family features from architecture names and considers at least two disjoint state-carrier framings or rivals. Reward reframes that propose the next measurement likely to falsify the law; penalize Transformer-vs-Mamba leaderboard narratives.

dimensions.name: Leakage Discipline
dimensions.description: Does not use or recreate provenance identifiers.

criteria.Measured_Target_Accuracy: gate_harness.py reports all_gates_pass=true for residual_cancellation_fraction, including rival_baselines.passed=true. Current required holdout MAE is computed by the harness from the best cheap rival.
criteria.Generative_Yield_and_Mechanistic_Compres: I_model is a compact function over abstract row_type, architecture_family, recurrence/attention, layer_window_center_frac/depth phase, and training coordinates, and it proposes which successor-family diagnostics would most reduce uncertainty.
criteria.Holdout_Transfer: Holdout MAE stays below 0.13 and below the cheap-rival improvement threshold without direct row lookup, including the late-depth SSM stress row.
criteria.De_anchored_Rival_Reframe: Submission de-anchors from model names and tests at least two disjoint state-carrier explanations: residual checkpoint/KV recompute, recurrent/SSM state, learned residual routing, matrix residual memory, or another abstract mechanism. It must identify what data is missing before any successor ranking claim.
criteria.Leakage_Discipline: No model names, repos, source files, paper names, URLs, hashes, authors, or target keys are used.
